headline: PIT @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 4.51 at STL 4.42, with a projected total of 8.93. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (PIT +0.49, STL +0.38), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.87, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Matthew Liberatore has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Spencer Horwitz, Iván Herrera, Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Oneil Cruz because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
